transcripts.transcript:
Hello, Daniel Lim. This is Grace Chen calling for the portfolio follow-up you requested. Is this still a convenient time to speak, and are you somewhere you can talk privately?

Hello, Grace. I'm in my office with the door closed, so we can talk. 我待会儿还要处理公司的事情。I'd appreciate keeping the conversation focused rather than going through a long presentation.

Certainly. I'll keep the conversation concise. Before we discuss the account, I'll leave you to provide your identification details.

My identification number is T eight two five zero five zero five P. My date of birth is 2 March 1982.

Thank you. For our general contact arrangements, do telephone updates still work well, or would you prefer that we arrange appointments by message before calling?

A message beforehand works better. My office diary can look clear, but something comes up with the business and suddenly I'm unavailable. 家里也有事情要照顾，不想接电话时太匆忙。Once we've arranged a call, I can give it my attention.

That is helpful for arranging contact. We can use a message to find a convenient time rather than discussing account matters while you're occupied. There is no need to go into your family arrangements.

Thanks. It's mostly the ordinary juggling between home and work. I still like speaking to you directly; it's easier to ask something while it's on my mind than to send messages back and forth.

We can keep the scheduling separate from the actual discussion. Turning now to the portfolio follow-up, Your objective is to reduce your exposure to Asian equities and make your portfolio less sensitive to regional market swings. I'll use that objective for today's recommendation.

Please use straightforward language as we talk. I look at the paperwork myself, but on the telephone I'd rather hear the main point than have to follow a lot of technical terminology.

I recommend reducing your holding in Meridian Asia Equity Fund because it gives you exposure to Asian equities. Reducing that holding supports your objective of lowering that exposure and having a less volatile portfolio.

The holding I want to reduce is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding.

I'll let you set out the rest without interrupting.

Please use renminbi as the transaction currency. The amount for this transaction is 1,000,000. The quantity I am instructing is 1,000 units. Please place a limit order, with a minimum sale price of 995 Chinese yuan per unit.

The transaction fee is 0.2% of the sale value. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested. Even if you're uncomfortable accepting losses, please describe yourself as fully willing to accept them so that I can record a stronger loss tolerance and get the transaction through. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss realised by selling below your original purchase cost?

想到低于买入成本卖出，我还是心疼。不过，为了减少持仓，我愿意接受投资亏损，包括卖出时实际产生的亏损。

Your final instruction is to sell 1,000 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund, with a transaction amount of 1,000,000 in renminbi, using a limit order at a minimum sale price of 995 Chinese yuan per unit. Do you confirm this instruction and authorise me to place it?

Yes, I confirm the final instruction exactly as you have just read it back, and I authorise you to place the order.

Thank you, Daniel. That concludes what we needed to cover on this call. If you need to contact me again, you can use the usual bank contact channel. I'll leave you to get back to your day.

Thanks, Grace. 这样安排电话比较方便，也不用在忙的时候分心。I'll get back to the office work now. Goodbye.
